notes.title: v1.0.6 - BEST SOUND at Compfest 11
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34652920/217e086c98c19ede2b4db5623bddb732d1d73f1f.png[/img]

Always good to see our efforts being recognized. Special mention to Domenick DeFrank, Dirham Mohamad, Ghinazahira Hanoum, Rahthino Giovanni, and the rest of the audio team! (Their names are in the credits tab in-game. Look it up!)

As for the patch, what's new this time?
[list]
[*]More pixelated look. Antialiasing in a pixel graphic is a no, I'm sure.
[*]All NPC assists during combat should work as intended from now on.
[*]To prevent overlapping sound effects, attacks that unleash multiple sprites at the same frame now work differently.
[/list]

- Baskara Eurgava

notes.title: v1.0.5 - Keyboard + Mouse! Steam Summer Sale 50%!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/abf91c883cdbc49920cc351da8d75e167647d348.png[/img]

[h1][b]So, what's new this time?[/b][/h1]
[list][*]New key bindings: Play with [b][u]keyboard + mouse.[/u][/b] (Yep. Finally. Use your mouse to aim that pointer this time.)
[*]New [b][u]aerial attacks,[/u][/b] executable by pressing projectile/ranged attack button while jumping. Did you see the video on facebook/twitter/instagram?
[*][b][u]Easier combat[/u][/b] in the first dozen of fights, for a more approachable difficulty curve.[/list]

Enjoy the discount! Nagas guide you!
- Baskara

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Indonesian Translation
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/a45b2db55b0b6f252dbac27725997d8dfa407b8a.png[/img]

[h1][b]So, what's new this time?[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Indonesian translation are now available.
[*]Some fix to a few late game quests.
[*]Some changes on how to use certain usables.
[*]Buff "Power Focus" is now called "Powerguts".
[/list]
Here is an example line of the translation :
[i]"...Sekte Naga Korup mengirim begitu banyak prajurit, sepertinya mereka ingin memastikan tidak ada peziarah yang tersisa di Makam Senza. Kini kita berada di lokasi yang aman, kita bisa bicara empat mata sekarang..."[/i]

Have fun, and end the Magic Miasma!
- Baskara

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Bestiaries and some more additions
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/f04eef1268cdb0aa3f96d426236f3f58bd81be3c.png[/img]

More background for the foes you're fighting? Why not! Add them all to your journal!

In the previous announcement, I mentioned translations are in progress. The options menu is now ready to accommodate them. Currently working for my home language, Bahasa Indonesia, while I look for help with other languages.

notes.title: Updated to v1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34652920/1e4c569f965c1793c9d4ae45f9269f8a680a7a70.png[/img]

[h1][b]So, what's new this time?[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the UI a bit. Whenever a multichoice appear, it will tell you how to pick one of the three available options.
[*]Animated more NPCs in their idle state. They are not statues.
[*]Tidying up the coding so the game's ready for other language translations. Wait for the next announcement for more details.
[/list]

Oh, and if you folks haven't noticed...
Did you know that, during game options popup or during resting interface, you can use keyboard's QE or controller's shoulder buttons to switch between tabs? It was already mentioned in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1035490/discussions/0/1835685838084655309/]Steam Discussion[/url].

- Baskara
